title: Concept: NuGet feed configured over cleartext
description: nuget.config declares a package source URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Packages and their content hashes cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the package the restore records.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: Packages and their content hashes cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the package the restore records.
